recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant 1960s-style composition featuring a central female figure in a gold sequined suit, flanked by smaller versions of herself, all integrated with massive, extruded sans-serif typography on a flat green field with a yellow border.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject overlapping and interacting with large-scale typography
Triadic color scheme of green, yellow, and gold
Repetition of the subject at varying scales to create depth
Contrast between flat graphic background and textured photographic subject
coreInvariants: Flat green background with a thin yellow perimeter border
Extruded 3D effect on primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject centered and large; secondary subjects scaled down and positioned within the negative space of the letterforms.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's torso and the massive yellow vertical strokes of the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Vertical movement driven by the elongated letterforms, balanced by the horizontal secondary text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The green background serves as a clean stage, allowing the complex textures of the sequins and the bold type to stand out.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone green background providing high contrast for warm tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for primary typography and borders.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold and black for texture and grounding.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation yellow against a muted green; high value contrast between black text and green background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to green, yellow, gold, and black

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tall x-height with elongated vertical strokes
Hard 90-degree extrusions to the right and down
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'A' and 'R' feature high-waisted crossbars to emphasize verticality

composition.overlap: behind and in front of subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme verticality paired with extreme horizontality.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and weight of the display type.
Matches the wide, geometric feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a flat green background with a thin yellow border. Place three photographic cutouts of a woman in a gold sequined suit: one large in the center, one smaller on the left, and one smaller on the right. Ensure the lighting is bright and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary display text in an extra-condensed yellow sans-serif with a 3D block extrusion. Layer the text so the central figure appears to step through the letters. Add the secondary text at the bottom in a wide, black, geometric sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text extruded to create a 3D effect?
Does the subject overlap the display text?
Is the green background flat without gradients?
Is the bottom text significantly wider than it is tall?

adjustableVariables: Extrusion depth of the display type
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for proper layering of subject and text
Ensure the yellow border is uniform
Verify the 3D extrusion direction is consistent
Confirm the gold texture looks metallic and reflective
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Extra-Condensed 3D Type] + [Textured Photographic Subject] + [Flat Color Field] + [Extended Geometric Subtitle].
